Subject: Joint GTM for Nimbus Analytics in APAC — ownership question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Nimbus (Priya copied) is evaluating Redwood for inference across several APAC accounts where our consultancy is the prime systems integrator. They asked whether Redwood prefers partner-led coverage (consultancy owns the AE/contact relationship with Redwood as partner) or direct AE coverage with a co-sell split.

Key asks from Nimbus:
- Can we establish partner-led routing for deals <= $950k ACV in APAC?
- If routed partner-led, what are the expectations for Redwood involvement (SSEs, PoC credits, deal desk approvals)?
- Any special contracting cadence / procurement constraints for APAC (Japan vs ANZ vs SEA) we should be aware of?

Attached a short partner briefing on the opportunity (basic numbers) — happy to jump on a call this week.

Best,
Elena
Partner Lead, Solstice Consulting

Elena — thanks for the clarity and the brief. CC'ing Camila (alliances) and Monica (CS/partnership ops) to weigh in.

High level from Redwood's side: we generally allow partner-led routing for consultancies on a case-by-case basis. Two things we need to confirm quickly for Nimbus:
1) Does Nimbus require RW FOE (field engineer) support for PoC and how long?
2) Are there any existing Redwood direct-sales opportunities with Nimbus accounts in EMEA or US that would create a conflict?

Camila / Monica — can you review and propose a simple routing policy we can commit to (e.g., partner-led for sub-$1M APAC deals, co-sell for above, escalation path if direct pipeline exists)? Also include typical credits (PoC credits, discount allowances) and the approval thresholds.

Elena / Priya — ping me with 30-min windows Wed/Thu next week and we can finalize a short mutual action plan if we can agree on routing.

Thanks,
Vivek

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint GTM for Nimbus Analytics in APAC — ownership question

Folks — I pulled together a one-page proposal in the attached workbook (tab: "Routing Proposal"). Summary recommendation:
- Partner-led for APAC deals <= $1.0M ACV where Solstice is the primary services/vendor contact and will own procurement.
- Co-sell (direct AE + partner) for deals between $1.0M–$2.5M to maintain Redwood commercial oversight.
- Direct-only for deals > $2.5M or where Redwood has an active net-new pipeline (AE has engaged within 90 days).

Operational guardrails:
- PoC support: up to 40 engineer hours for partner-led deals under $500k (trial credits); for >$500k apply to Deal Desk for additional credits.
- Discounts: alliance-managed discounts capped at 12% for partner-led; any exceptions require VP approval.
- Territory carve: Solstice can own APAC SEA and ANZ for Nimbus, but Japan requires a local account review due to procurement language variability.

If this looks fine I can draft a one-page MOP to send to Nimbus and include acceptance checkboxes for each region.

Camila Reyes
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference

- We discovered an existing Redwood proof-of-concept with Nimbus Japan (small POC started May 2027 via direct AE). That creates a potential conflict for Japan. Recommend we mark Japan as "requires direct review" and route to the AE for reconciliation.
- For reporting: we will set the partner-led deals to a partner-sourced pipeline stage in HubSpot (HS-432198). Please ensure Solstice uses our partner SKU naming and includes partner-sourced tag; ops will reconcile weekly.
- Attachment: I added a short "Reconciliation flow" to the mapping workbook (tab: ReconcileFlow).

If Camila is OK, propose we send the MOP to Nimbus but flag Japan for AE review and propose a separate mini MOP for Japan.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Nimbus Analytics — routing agreement and next steps

Elena / Priya — thanks for bearing with the internal triage. Final plan we can commit to: 
1) Solstice (consultancy) will be partner-led owner for APAC SEA + ANZ for deals <= $1.0M ACV. Redwood will provide PoC support as outlined (up to 40 engineer hours under $500k).
2) Japan: flagged for AE reconciliation — we will not route partner-led without explicit AE sign-off. Monica to coordinate with AE and return by EOD Jul 23.
3) For deals > $1.0M, we will default to co-sell; >$2.5M requires direct sales ownership unless otherwise approved.

Next steps:
- Camila to send a one-page MOP to Nimbus (includes regional checkboxes + PoC/credit table).
- Solstice to confirm acceptance and provide a short statement of work template they will use for partner-sourced deals.
- Ops (Monica) to add partner-sourced tagging in HubSpot (HS-432198) and begin weekly reconciliation.

If that matches your expectations, sign off by replying with "AGREE" and I'll log the agreement in our partner portal.

Warm regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
